channel.description: Latest articles from The Logical Indian (thelogicalindian.com)

item.title: After Government Intervention, Blinkit Scraps 10-Minute Delivery; Zepto, Swiggy Likely to Follow
item.description: Government intervention and nationwide gig worker protests have pushed quick-commerce platforms to abandon risky ultra-fast delivery promises.

item.title: ‘For Every Bite, Every Death, You Pay’: Supreme Court Signals Heavy Liability For States And Feeders Over Stray Dog Attacks
item.description: The Supreme Court has questioned state inaction on stray dog attacks, signalling strict liability for bites, deaths, and lifelong injuries.

item.title: ‘Someone Had to Step Up’: How a Madurai Startup Is Giving Chennai Cleaner, Safer Public Toilets
item.description: Thooya Innovation, the groundbreaking startup solution, is revolutionizing urban hygiene by replacing filthy public toilets with high-quality, free-to-use Loocafes, restoring dignity and safety to city dwellers across Tamil Nadu.

item.title: J&K Reports Pakistan-Origin Drones Sighted along Line of Control for Second Time within 48 Hours
item.description: Fresh drone sightings across Jammu and Kashmir have heightened border alertness as India urges Pakistan to halt aerial intrusions and prevent escalation.

item.title: Medicine Meant for Children Turns Hazardous: Telangana Pulls Almont-Kid Syrup Over Toxic Contamination
item.description: Telangana health authorities have halted a children’s syrup after tests found ethylene glycol, urging parents to stop its use immediately.

item.title: India to Mandate Vehicle-to-Vehicle Communication in New Cars, Allocates 30 MHz Spectrum to Prevent Crashes
item.description: India is preparing to mandate vehicle-to-vehicle communication in all new cars, allocating a dedicated 30 MHz spectrum to enable real-time alerts between vehicles, a move officials say could significantly reduce road collisions and save lives. In a significant step towards improving road safety, the Indian government has announced plans to make vehicle-to-vehicle (V2V) communication mandatory […]

item.title: Final Act Of Valour: Army Veteran Saves Multiple Lives Through Organ Donation In Lucknow
item.description: A final act of service: a 61-year-old Army Medical Corps veteran’s organ donation brought life and sight to others, even amid adversity.

item.title: Why Schengen Travel Insurance Is Mandatory & How to Get It?
item.description: Schengen visas demand €30,000 medical coverage insurance for Indians, easily bought online to dodge rejections and medical shocks.

item.title: Chennai Sanitation Worker Finds Gold Worth Rs 45 Lakh on Road, Returns It With Inspiring Honesty; Honoured By CM
item.description: Chennai sanitation worker S. Padma found 45 sovereigns of gold worth Rs 45 lakh and returned it.

item.title: Germany Eases Airport Transit Rules: Here’s What It Means for Indians
item.description: Germany has announced visa-free airport transit for Indian travellers at major hubs, though the rule’s implementation is still awaited.
